def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    hr=[r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0]
    sep=g[hr[0]][0] if hr else None
    if sep is None: return g
    vr=[c for c in range(w) if all(row[c]==sep for row in g)]
    r_bounds=[-1]+hr+[h]
    c_bounds=[-1]+vr+[w]
    r_spans=[(r_bounds[i]+1,r_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(r_bounds)-1)]
    c_spans=[(c_bounds[i]+1,c_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(c_bounds)-1)]
    rh=max(b-a for a,b in r_spans); cw=max(b-a for a,b in c_spans)
    r_spans=[(a,b) for a,b in r_spans if b-a==rh]
    c_spans=[(a,b) for a,b in c_spans if b-a==cw]
    def panel(ri,ci):
        a,b=r_spans[ri]; x,y=c_spans[ci]
        return [row[x:y] for row in g[a:b]]
    def nonempty(p): return any(v for row in p for v in row)
    def flip(p): return p[::-1]
    for ri in range(len(r_spans)-1):
        active=False
        for ci in range(len(c_spans)):
            p,q=panel(ri,ci),panel(ri+1,ci)
            if nonempty(p) and nonempty(q) and p==flip(q):
                active=True; break
        if not active: continue
        for ci in range(len(c_spans)):
            p,q=panel(ri,ci),panel(ri+1,ci)
            if nonempty(p) and not nonempty(q):
                a,b=r_spans[ri+1]; x,y=c_spans[ci]
                for k,row in enumerate(flip(p)): g[a+k][x:y]=row[:]
            elif nonempty(q) and not nonempty(p):
                a,b=r_spans[ri]; x,y=c_spans[ci]
                for k,row in enumerate(flip(q)): g[a+k][x:y]=row[:]
    return g

    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    hr = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    if not hr:
        return g
    sep = g[hr[0]][0]
    vr = [c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == sep for row in g)]
    rb = [-1] + hr + [h]
    cb = [-1] + vr + [w]
    rs = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]
    cs = [(cb[i] + 1, cb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cb) - 1)]
    rh = max(b - a for a, b in rs)
    cw = max(b - a for a, b in cs)
    rs = [(a, b) for a, b in rs if b - a == rh]
    cs = [(a, b) for a, b in cs if b - a == cw]

    def get_panel(ri, ci):
        a, b = rs[ri]
        x, y = cs[ci]
        return [row[x:y] for row in g[a:b]]

    def filled(panel):
        return any(value != 0 for row in panel for value in row)

    for ri in range(len(rs) - 1):

            and filled(q := get_panel(ri + 1, ci))

            for ci in range(len(cs))

            top, bottom = get_panel(ri, ci), get_panel(ri + 1, ci)
            if filled(top) and not filled(bottom):
                a, _ = rs[ri + 1]
                x, y = cs[ci]

                a, _ = rs[ri]
                x, y = cs[ci]
                for k, row in enumerate(bottom[::-1]):

'''
